about: GET /api/ticket/{slug} (meter/tickets.py ticket_card), captured from the route with the chain scripted. `ticketed` is a title with a ticket contract; `free` is one without, free to download.

ticketed.rails_note: every rail the CONTRACT has, in its own order. The owner may post an arbitrary one with setRail(railId>=6, kind, token, id, amount, sink, label) — any ERC-20, ERC-721 or ERC-1155 — and it appears here the moment it does, with no edit to this service. Buy any of them with buyWithRail(railId, nftIds). A rail with amount 0 is SHUT, not free.

elo.where_it_goes: straight to the fee splitter — 10% burns under the posted split once distribute() runs; no burn is claimed before it has

where.text: straight to the fee splitter — 10% burns under the posted split once distribute() runs; no burn is claimed before it has

ticketed.drift_note: usd_now is each rail's posted amount valued at the live tape, as a multiple of the posted dollar price — 1.0 is exact, and a number far from 1.0 means the posted amount is stale; the contract owner reposts amounts, the dollar price stands

free_mint.how: mintFree(yourWallet) from your own wallet — free, you pay only the gas

how_to_buy.eth: buyWithETH() with msg.value = the posted amount, exactly
how_to_buy.closed_rails: a rail posted at 0 is shut and is named nowhere above; every rail at 0 closes the sale without closing resale
how_to_buy.resale: tickets are ordinary ERC-721s — royalty is a constant 0
how_to_buy.agents: GET /api/ticket/gates/prepare — signable calldata for your own wallet

ticketed.licence: holding ANY ticket of this title is the licence: the official servers ask balanceOf and nothing else — at join, and again on an interval, so selling the copy mid-session is a kick, not a loophole (POST /api/ticket/gates/check is the roster sweep)
ticketed.download: open — the game is open source and the bytes were never the secret; the licence bites at the official servers

venues.we_run_none_of_these: Elo runs no marketplace. A game you bought here is a standard ERC-721 on chain 4663, so it trades anywhere that supports the chain.

places.name: the explorer
places.what: the contract, its source, its transfers and its holders

places.name: OpenSea
places.what: buy and sell this game. It sets its own fee; this ticket asks it for an ERC-2981 royalty of a constant 0, so no key here taxes your exit

ticketed.scope: a ticket gates entry, never a score, a rank, odds, or a payout

free.what: this title has no ticket contract configured, so it is free to download — nothing here is for sale
free.arms_with: SCRY_TICKET_FREEBIE=0x… on the meter, after the title's ticket deploys (contracts/script/DeployGameTicket.s.sol)
